title: Distributed checkpoint
prompt: Simulated message bus, deterministic: implement class `IdempotentProcessor` with `int Process(string messageId, Func<int> work)` — processes work once per messageId, caches the result, returns it on repeats WITHOUT re-running work (work has a side-effect counter the test watches). Then implement `static int[] DeliverAll(List<string> messageIds, Func<string, int> handler, int duplicates)` that delivers every message `duplicates` times (out of order, shuffled deterministically by index) and returns the work-counter delta — which must be exactly messageIds.Count because duplicates are absorbed idempotently.

tests.name: process-once
tests.hint: Dictionary<string,int> cache: TryGetValue → return; else compute, store, return.

tests.name: duplicates-absorbed
tests.hint: DeliverAll: one shared IdempotentProcessor; deliver each id `duplicates` times; count runs before/after.
